description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ New
- Health: The Cluster and Workloads overviews are now a single Health page, with the option to break it down by namespace.
- Port Forwarding: Port forwards to a Service or a workload now follow its pods. If the pod goes away, the port forward moves to another running one
- Port Forwarding: Redesigned the Port Forwards manager and sidebar section to match the new design system.
- Port Forwarding: You can now save port forwards and start them again later from the sidebar, or all at once with Start All
- Contexts: You can now give a context an alias in Context Settings, or with alias: in the Kubeconfig extension. It's shown instead of the context name everywhere in the app, while kubectl, Helm and terminals keep using the real context name
- Access Control: Added CertificateSigningRequests, as CSRs in the sidebar and csr in the Command Palette
💎 Improvements
- Performance: Improved performance when listing a large number of Pods.
- Detail Views: When something else deletes the object you're looking at, the view now stays open with a "Deleted X minutes ago", so you can keep viewing the logs instead of being redirected away.
- Helm: Uninstall now runs in the background with a progress toast, like upgrade and rollback.
- In-App Terminal: Cluster shell tabs show the context avatar instead of color strips
🐞 Fixes
- Port Forwarding: Port forwards now pick a running, ready pod instead of the first one listed, which could be Pending or Terminating.
- Linux: Fixed Ctrl+V in the YAML and ConfigMap editors splitting the line when pasting a copied line, or doing nothing at all
- Context Icons: icon: github.com in the Kubeconfig extension and a website address like https://github.com in the icon picker now show that site's icon
